operator_io_quirks: All identifiers lowercase, no spaces; still must double-quote in generated SQL.
university_ranking_year and university_year have NO primary key (pk=[]); sample_fresh_primary_keys must no-op on empty PK.
Both no-PK tables are pure fact tables with FK columns to university/ranking_criteria; FK fill draws from parent's final filtered column.
ranking_system.system_name sample is 40 chars ('Times Higher Education World University ') — String length range must accommodate long text.
student_staff_ratio is REAL with values like 8.9; Number fuzzer with scale from 'REAL' (no args) -> default scale, int perturbation not float.
year columns are INTEGER storing 2011..2022; Number fuzzer will produce values in [-10^scale,10^scale] not year-like — no Date dispatch.
score has 0.4% NULLs and pct_female_students 8.8% NULLs; other columns 0% NULL — TS drops None elements in Base, so NULLs rarely generated.
university_ranking_year.university_id distinct=1065 < university rows 1247 (some universities unranked); FK fill with replacement still fine.
university_year.university_id distinct=245 only — many universities lack year rows; FK sampling from parent's full id list is fine.
ranking_criteria.ranking_system_id distinct=3 = ranking_system rows; FK to tiny parent (3 rows) means heavy duplication in child.
No composite keys, no self-FKs, no dangling FKs, no text-stored dates, no storage/declared-type contradictions.
All FKs parent_exists=true and parent PKs are single-column INTEGER — clean topological order: country/ranking_system -> ranking_criteria/university -> *_year.
operator_ts_expectations: All columns dispatch to Number or String fuzzer; no Date/Time/Bool/Bit/Year dispatch on this DB.
Number fuzzer on INTEGER PKs: fresh draws uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] then +-1/+-2 perturbation; PK uniqueness enforced by sample_fresh_primary_keys, so PKs plausible-ish but not 1..N.
Number fuzzer on year: values like 2011 come from literal pool (5 originals + pool), but fresh draws are huge ints — implausible years drive FN on year predicates.
Number fuzzer on score/pct_*: fresh draws span full [-10^scale,10^scale], so scores outside 0..100 and pct outside 0..100 — implausible, FN on range predicates.
String fuzzer on country_name/university_name: 5 originals + pool + fresh random CHARSET strings with contamination — mostly gibberish, FN on LIKE/equality on names.
String fuzzer on criteria_name/system_name: same; system_name long sample sets length range up to 40, fresh strings up to that length.

FK fill draws from parent's final column with replacement: university_ranking_year.university_id will be a subset of generated university ids (good), but ranking_criteria_id from only 3 ranking_system ids if parent tiny — actually from ranking_criteria's 21 ids.
No-PK tables: no PK dedup, so duplicate (university_id, ranking_criteria_id, year) tuples likely — FP risk on DISTINCT/COUNT(DISTINCT) queries vs original's near-unique tuples.
university_year has no PK: duplicate (university_id, year) rows likely — FP on queries assuming one row per university-year.
student_staff_ratio REAL: Number fuzzer float perturbation +-0.01/+-0.02; fresh draws huge — implausible ratios, FN on ratio predicates.
score NULLs (0.4%) and pct_female NULLs (8.8%) in original; TS Base drops None so generated instances have ~0 NULLs — FP on IS NULL / COUNT(*) vs COUNT(col) queries.

Small tables (country 74, ranking_system 3, ranking_criteria 21) get sizes from choose_table_sizes (30..230 or level-based); ranking_system may get 30+ rows vs original 3 — cardinality mismatch, FP on COUNT(*) on ranking_system.
